from fastapi import APIRouter, UploadFile, File, Depends, HTTPException
import pandas as pd
import pandera as pa
import io

router = APIRouter(prefix="/ml/feature-store")

@router.post("/{repo_id}/validate-dataset")
async def validate_feature_store_dataset(
    repo_id: str,
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    feature_registry: FeatureStoreRegistry = Depends(get_feature_registry),
    current_engineer: MLEngineer = Depends(get_current_engineer)
):
    repo = await feature_registry.get_feature_repo(repo_id)
    if not repo:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Feature repository not found")

    content = await file.read()
    df = pd.read_parquet(io.BytesIO(content))
    baseline_schema = repo.pandera_schema
    try:
        baseline_schema.validate(df)
    except pa.errors.SchemaErrors as err:
        return {"repo_id": repo_id, "valid": False, "failure_cases": err.failure_cases.to_dict()}

    return {
        "repo_id": repo_id,
        "valid": True,
        "feature_count": len(df.columns),
        "baseline_distributions": repo.feature_statistics
    }
